ops.body: Review clarification for delta-1 D7: retaining newer session bytes while code capture is deferred is useful, but that mixed checkpoint must remain partial/not-ready. Default pickup and ACK readiness must still select the previous COMPLETE grouped checkpoint, not label latest transcript + older code as a complete recovery point merely because the older code manifest verifies. Preserve code_state/deferred age in UI; do not silently downgrade the approved session+code consistency guarantee. Add a test with a new transcript turn after code capture becomes Deferred/Partial/MissingLFS.
